error.message: Invalid type 'bogus'. Valid types: req, scenario, test, adr, flag, event, symbol, fact. Use a single type value, or omit this parameter to query all entities.

tool.description: List KB entities by the relationships they lack or have. Use for questions like which requirements lack scenarios or tests; all filters must match, and a relationship counts in either direction. Use kb_coverage instead for proof status and repair plans, and kb_check for rule violations. No mutation side effects.

kb.description: Optional KB dependency to read instead of this project's own KB: a name declared in .kb/dependencies.json and pinned in .kb/dependencies.lock.json. The answer comes from that repository's own read-only KB at the pinned commit, kept apart from this project's KB. Omit it to read this project's KB.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return; count reports the full total.

missingRelationships.description: Relationship types the entity must have none of, in either direction, for example specified_by or verified_by. verified_by and validates satisfy each other.

presentRelationships.description: Relationship types the entity must have at least one of each, in either direction.

sourceFile.description: Keep entities whose source path contains this substring.

tags.description: Keep entities carrying any of these metadata tags. Bootstrap provenance stubs appear in rows only when this names bootstrap:provenance-stub.

type.description: Only report entities of this type. Omit for all types.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute path of the workspace this call is about when it differs from the one the server started in, for example the git worktree you are working in. The server answers from that workspace's knowledge base when it is a worktree of the same repository or lies under the client's MCP roots; otherwise it answers from its own workspace and adds a workspace_mismatch diagnostic. Host hooks fill this in automatically where available.

tool.name: kb_find_gaps
